svg.title: Vaporia — Scald and Steam. Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance (roster pass) / Boil classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Rising Steam forks into Geyser Fist then Caldera Burst, or Blistering Mist then Boiling Point. Vapor Shroud forks into Siphoned Heat then Dew of the Dragon, or Scalding Backlash then Wall of Steam. No paths converge. Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Boil jutsu.

Rising Steam answers \"How do I make the rush hit harder: scald everyone around me or brand one target?\": the Burst route commits +1 Damage on Geyser Fist and Caldera Burst pays off with +1 Damage more (+2 on all three attacks, no tier crossing) and Drowning Strike's spiral exposure at 40%, Boiling Point brands the Shell's target with +10% Afterburn. Vapor Shroud answers \"How do I outlast the exchange: heal through my own hits or punish theirs?\": Dew of the Dragon reaches the +5% Lifesteal ceiling with a palm Heal rider, Wall of Steam returns 50% of incoming hits behind 35% Decrease Damage Taken. +2 Damage made 01,02,04,05 the strongest build; Vapor Shroud drops its +2% Heal glue. Geyser Fist becomes a +1 Damage commit and Caldera Burst carries +1 Damage with the +3% exposure, so Burst's 3-BP package is unchanged (+2 Damage, +2% Increase Damage Given, +5% Increase Damage Taken) and exposure past Rising Steam's 37% is Burst-only. Conventions: no 50 EP row (R1 n/a); Caldera Burst carries the flat-Damage payoff (R2); exposure +5% and Afterburn +10% each reach one row (R3); no twin Hidden Arts (R4); +2 on 40/45 rows, no tier crossing (R5); 10 nodes, 2-4-4, neither Foundation universal (R7). R6 departure: Geyser Fist keeps +1 Damage on a Hidden Art because no percentage set-up passes the fourth-BP audit: exposure and the Shell's Increase Damage Given both multiply the sibling Afterburn, and Decrease Damage Taken, Lifesteal, Reflect and Heal are the defensive branch's tags. A bare +1 capstone would copy the commit and leave Burst + Blistering Mist 2.6% behind Burn + Geyser Fist on the kit's attacks (108.8 against 111.6 EP-equivalent), so Caldera Burst pairs its +1 with the exposure.","Maxima over every legal allocation: Damage +2 (40 \u2192 42, 45 \u2192 47; builds with Geyser Fist but not Caldera Burst stop at +1, 41 / 46), Increase Damage Given +2%, Increase Damage Taken +5% (Burst only; +2% elsewhere), Decrease Damage Taken +5%, Afterburn +10%, Lifesteal +5%, Reflect +10%, Heal +5%. No capstone shares a tag with its sibling Hidden Art.","Delivery at the pin: SELF rows land on the caster once per cast (actions.ts 980\u20131004, 1062\u20131066), so Surfing Strike's Decrease Damage Taken, Scorch Break's Reflect and the Shell's Lifesteal and Increase Damage Given are plain 2-round self buffs. Drowning Strike's rows are INHERIT rows on a GROUND spiral of radius 4 around the caster (own tile excluded); its 2-round exposure is a ground effect re-applied each round to whoever stands on a tile.","Interactions: the Shell's three rows and Drowning Strike's exposure are Taijutsu-filtered but element-less, so they match every element-less hit of any stat type plus Taijutsu elemental hits, the three Boil attacks included; Afterburn reads the hit after Increase Damage Given and Increase Damage Taken. Damage modifiers and Afterburn skip pierce; Lifesteal and Reflect include it. The bloodline Increase Damage Given passive multiplies last.","Uptime: every jutsu has cooldown 7. Buff, exposure and Afterburn windows are the 2 rounds after the cast.","Fourth purchases: Burst (01,02,03) + Blistering Mist or Vapor Shroud; Burn (01,04,05) + Geyser Fist or Vapor Shroud; Sustain (06,07,08) + Rising Steam or Scalding Backlash; Retaliation (06,09,10) + Siphoned Heat or Rising Steam. The strongest are the offensive siblings. On a Shell-branded target standing in the spiral, during the Shell buff (Shell and Drowning Strike fit one 100 AP round), Burst + Blistering Mist gives \u00d71.37 \u00d7 1.40 \u00d7 1.38 \u2248 \u00d72.65 on 42 EP follow-ups (111.2 EP-equivalent on a 40 EP base) and Burn + Geyser Fist \u00d71.37 \u00d7 1.37 \u00d7 1.45 \u2248 \u00d72.72 on 41 EP (111.6), against the kit's \u00d71.35 \u00d7 1.35 \u00d7 1.35 \u2248 \u00d72.46 (98.4). Allies' hits on that target take \u00d71.37 \u00d7 1.45 \u2248 \u00d71.99 under Burn (\u00d72.03 with the old Geyser Fist) against \u00d71.40 \u00d7 1.38 \u2248 \u00d71.93 under Burst; every other target in the spiral takes 80.6 from a Burst follow-up on a 40 EP base against 77.0 under Burn. Both give up all mitigation. Retaliation + Rising Steam is the highest row-weighted build only because Rising Steam touches two glue rows; it stacks no tag with the capstone."],"risks":["Classification: Boil is the single signature element on the three Damage rows and no other captured bloodline has Boil jutsu; ordinary Boil jutsu are in scope by rule and unverified. 3 of 10 supported kit rows carry Boil; the other seven need the proposed jutsu-classification resolver, and Liquid Ember Shell (no Boil row) qualifies in-kit only through an authored Boil jutsu classification (ENGINE_GAP_REGISTER G1).","Ally hazard (validator warns): Drowning Strike's Increase Damage Taken is an INHERIT ground row with friendly fire none (=ALL); allies on a spiral tile, and the caster if it steps onto one, take the exposure too. g.text: Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Boil jutsu. Combat scopes stay unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Dew of the Dragon path + Rising Steam
Wall of Steam path + Siphoned Heat
IDG: Increase Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken · AB: Afterburn · LS: Lifesteal · REF: Reflect · HEAL: Heal
FINAL TAG VALUES ON THE VAPORIA KIT
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Liquid Ember Shell · Increase Damage Given
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Afterburn is an enemy debuff: while it lasts, damage the target takes adds Afterburn damage at the debuff percentage (60% cap per hit).
On a static Heal effect each +1% Heal adds 1 heal power, which heals 10 HP per tick (display conflict under review).
Lifesteal shares a 60%-of-hit leech budget with vamp; Reflect returns at most 60% of a hit.
Proposed behavior: needs a jutsu-classification potency resolver. The current resolver matches each effect's own elements.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance (roster pass) / Boil classification / forked tree
